👑 Jensen Huang's Nvidia comeback isn't the end of the story — Congress still wants answers.

Nvidia's board unanimously voted to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO this week after an 11-day exit. But the US Senate Banking Committee, chaired by Sen. Tim Scott, says he must now face two rounds of Congressional testimony:

📅 Dec 1 — closed-door testimony before three House committees
📅 Dec 3 — public hearing before the Senate Banking Committee, focused on oversight of US chip export controls

Nvidia has also set up its own export-control compliance committee in the past week and is hiring a Chief Compliance Officer. Sen. Elizabeth Warren says Huang, Nvidia's executives, and its board "still owe Congress answers" on export compliance.

🕓 Published: 03:52 GMT+3
